gloss: redeeming quality; merit; forte; strong point

definitions.explanation: A positive characteristic or skill that makes someone or something valuable.

examples.english: My only redeeming quality is that I'm healthy.
This shop's strong point is that it's cheap.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{柄|え}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}って→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{努力家|どりょくか}→努力家：22284_doryokuka⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I thought I had no strong points, but I was told I'm hardworking.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take) + ⟦{柄|え}→柄：01924_e⟧ (handle, merit)

USAGE:
Often used in modest or self-deprecating contexts:
- {取|と}り{柄|え}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have no redeeming qualities)
- ⟦{唯一|ゆいいつ}→唯一：01666_yuiitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{柄|え} (only strong point)

COMMON PATTERN:
「〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{取|と}り{柄|え}」 (X is one's/its strong point)
- ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{取|と}り{柄|え} (being energetic is my forte)
- ⟦{安|やす}さ→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{取|と}り{柄|え} (cheapness is its selling point)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長所|ちょうしょ}→長所：03121_chousho⟧ - strength, merit (more formal)
- ⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧ - specialty, strong suit
